Pulse 0.9.0

What's new:
- Record position trades: buys and sells replay into a transaction ledger that derives quantity, moving-average cost, and realized P&L. The position page becomes a hub with buy/sell entries, a monthly trade log with delete, and a quick-set editor for calibrating without itemizing.
- Short positions: sell first to open a short — the average blends your short entry prices, buying back covers and realizes P&L, and trades crossing zero flip sides at the trade price. Short quantities simply display as negatives.
- Outside regular hours, the detail page now shows the last regular close and its own day change next to the live pre-market, post-market, or overnight price.
- Indices (NASDAQ Composite, S&P 500, …) no longer draw pre/post wings, session shading, or session labels — they compute during regular hours only.
- Watchlist trend lines always frame the regular session; the extended-hours setting now applies to the detail chart only.
- The watchlist context menu gains native multi-select group membership (deselect to remove, including from the last group) and a reorder entry; position pages disclose the full trade log from their section headers, and the detail position summary opens the position hub directly.
- Trade buttons adopt the flat tinted style of the surrounding pages, and negative amounts format as -$120.00.

For first-time installation, download Pulse-0.9.0.dmg and drag Pulse to Applications. The zip asset is used by Sparkle automatic updates.
